pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "der Löffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. window
   C. spoon
   D. house

2. Which of these is a piece of furniture? (1 mark)
   A. der Garten
   B. das Haus
   C. der Stuhl
   D. die Küche

3. How is "ie" pronounced in "Dienstag"? (1 mark)
   A. like ow
   B. like ee
   C. like oy
   D. like eye

4. What does "die Kerze" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. balloon
   B. candle
   C. song
   D. cake

5. What number is "achtzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 18
   C. 14
   D. 8

6. Which sentence means "I like eating bananas"? (1 mark)
   A. Ich trinke gern Bananen.
   B. Ich koche Bananen.
   C. Ich esse keine Bananen.
   D. Ich esse gern Bananen.

7. What does "der Rücken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. back
   B. toe
   C. ear
   D. finger

8. What does "Bis morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. see you tomorrow
   B. thank you
   C. good day (daytime greeting)
   D. yes

9. What does "Guten Morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good morning
   B. good day (daytime greeting)
   C. please
   D. sorry, excuse me

10. Which German word must begin with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. und
   B. Mutter
   C. ist
   D. nett

11. What does "stark" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hard-working
   B. small
   C. old
   D. strong

12. What does "hinter dem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. in front of the house
   B. next to the house
   C. behind the house
   D. on the house

13. What does "oft" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. tomorrow
   C. always
   D. yesterday

14. What does "der Dienstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Thursday
   C. week
   D. Tuesday

15. Which German word is the number 7? (1 mark)
   A. neun
   B. achtzehn
   C. sieben
   D. acht

16. What does "Juli" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. July
   B. November
   C. January
   D. September

17. What does "Kamau hat Geburtstag" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau has a cake
   B. Kamau has a birthday
   C. Kamau is ten
   D. Kamau is tired

18. What does "denn" mean in "Ich mag keine Cola, denn Cola ist nicht gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. because
   B. but
   C. and
   D. then

19. What does "das Wasser" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. banana
   B. water
   C. tea
   D. bean

20. What does "warum" ask? (1 mark)
   A. When
   B. Why
   C. Where
   D. Who

21. What does "die Nase" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. nose
   B. hair
   C. head
   D. hand

22. What does "Regenzeit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. rainy season
   B. rainbow
   C. dry season
   D. thunder

23. Which German word means "under"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. hinter
   C. unter
   D. über

24. What does "neben" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. next to
   B. on
   C. under
   D. in front of

25. What does "Was macht sie?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where is she?
   B. How old is she?
   C. Who is she?
   D. What is she doing?

26. Which is a safe way to send a greeting message? (1 mark)
   A. Write only to people you know
   B. Send your address to anyone
   C. Share passwords
   D. Write to strangers

27. Which form completes "Wir ___ Geschwister"? (1 mark)
   A. ist
   B. bist
   C. sind
   D. bin

28. Which little word goes with the noun "Schrank"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

29. What do you label on a floor plan? (1 mark)
   A. the meals
   B. the weather
   C. the days
   D. the rooms

30. Which German word or phrase means "fork"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wohnzimmer
   B. das Zimmer
   C. die Küche
   D. die Gabel

31. Which German word or phrase means "Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Mittwoch
   B. der Dienstag
   C. der Montag
   D. der Sonntag

32. Which little word goes with the noun "Dienstag"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. das
   D. die

33. Which little word goes with the noun "Wochenende"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

34. Which German word or phrase means "apple"? (1 mark)
   A. der Fisch
   B. der Apfel
   C. das Brot
   D. das Fleisch

35. Which form completes "Obst ___ gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. bin
   B. bist
   C. ist
   D. sind

36. What is the plural of "der Apfel"? (1 mark)
   A. die Apfels
   B. die Äpfel
   C. die Apfele
   D. die Apfeler

37. Which German word or phrase means "toe"? (1 mark)
   A. der Finger
   B. der Zeh
   C. der Fuß
   D. der Bauch

38. Which little word goes with the noun "Schulter"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

39. Which little word goes with the noun "Bauch"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. das
   D. die

40. What does "neblig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. hot
   C. dry
   D. foggy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer. (3 marks)

42. Write three steps you follow to understand a German text. (3 marks)

43. Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well. (3 marks)

44. Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home. (3 marks)

45. Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader. (2 marks)

46. Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room. (4 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato. (2 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen. (5 marks)

49. Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink. (3 marks)

50. Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12. (3 marks)

51. Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is. (2 marks)

52. Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German. (3 marks)

53. Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means. (2 marks)

54. Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday. (2 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa. (3 marks)

56. Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed." (2 marks)

57. Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg. (3 marks)

58. Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example. (2 marks)

59. Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER. (2 marks)

60. Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday." (2 marks)

61. Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German. (2 marks)

62. Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß. (2 marks)

63. Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — spoon
   der Löffel means spoon.

2. C — der Stuhl
   A chair (der Stuhl) is furniture. The others are places.

3. B — like ee
   The letters ie sound like ee.

4. B — candle
   die Kerze means candle.

5. B — 18
   achtzehn is the number 18.

6. D — Ich esse gern Bananen.
   gern shows you like doing it.

7. A — back
   der Rücken means back.

8. A — see you tomorrow
   Bis morgen means see you tomorrow.

9. A — good morning
   Guten Morgen means good morning.

10. B — Mutter
   German nouns always begin with a capital letter.

11. D — strong
   stark means strong.

12. C — behind the house
   hinter means behind.

13. A — often
   oft means often.

14. D — Tuesday
   der Dienstag means Tuesday.

15. C — sieben
   7 in German is sieben.

16. A — July
   Juli means July.

17. B — Kamau has a birthday
   hat Geburtstag means has a birthday.

18. A — because
   denn gives a reason.

19. B — water
   das Wasser means water.

20. B — Why
   warum means why.

21. A — nose
   die Nase means nose.

22. A — rainy season
   Regen = rain and Zeit = time.

23. C — unter
   under in German is unter.

24. A — next to
   neben means next to.

25. D — What is she doing?
   was macht sie means what does she do.

26. A — Write only to people you know
   We stay safe online by writing to people we know.

27. C — sind
   wir goes with sind.

28. A — der
   It is der Schrank, so the little word is der.

29. D — the rooms
   A floor plan is a picture of the rooms seen from above.

30. D — die Gabel
   fork in German is die Gabel.

31. A — der Mittwoch
   Wednesday in German is der Mittwoch.

32. A — der
   It is der Dienstag, so the little word is der.

33. A — das
   It is das Wochenende, so the little word is das.

34. B — der Apfel
   apple in German is der Apfel.

35. C — ist
   Obst is treated as one group, so we say ist.

36. B — die Äpfel
   The plural of der Apfel is die Äpfel.

37. B — der Zeh
   toe in German is der Zeh.

38. D — die
   It is die Schulter, so the little word is die.

39. A — der
   It is der Bauch, so the little word is der.

40. D — foggy
   neblig means foggy.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: kalt and Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.
